schema.title: Response Web Service Access Check Api Check Post

post.summary: Retrieve information on defined projects matching criteria

get.description: Returns the effective <script> string after token substitution and whitelist check, or 204 when disabled. No authentication required; works pre-login and for shared sessions. Restart required for config changes.

magic_token.title: Magic Token
magic_token.description: Assigned token key on project creation to identify this project in external URLs or resources.

project_tag.title: Project Tag
project_tag.description: A unique project tag within the customer that is associated with a unique product/service

project_title.title: Project Title
project_title.description: A unique project title within the customer that is associated with a unique product/service

project_description.title: Project Description
project_description.description: The description of this specific project associated with the customer

project_exclusive_mode.title: Project Exclusive Mode
project_exclusive_mode.description: Pick one mode (true): select a single winner. Rank all mode (false): full option ranking.

ranking_mode.title: Ranking Mode
ranking_mode.description: Compare target: find_best, find_top_3, find_top_half, or rank_all

private_participation.title: Private Participation
private_participation.description: When true, individual participant names are hidden in reports and views; labels use unique participant N per view

participant_influence_mode.title: Participant Influence Mode
participant_influence_mode.description: How group Results balance influence: comparisons (each comparison equal), balanced (moderate participant normalization), participants_normalized (strong participant normalization, not fully equal)

participant_influence_min_comparisons.title: Participant Influence Min Comparisons
participant_influence_min_comparisons.description: Soft floor on calculable comparisons before participant influence is amplified (minimum 3)

factor_weight_floor_alpha.title: Factor Weight Floor Alpha
factor_weight_floor_alpha.description: Scales the factor-weight floor as alpha×(n−1) before normalizing importance weights. Lower = more spread between factors; higher = more equal. Default 0.5 matches classic 75/25 for two clear ranks.

min_expected_passes.title: Min Expected Passes
min_expected_passes.description: Target minimum sort passes per participant (1–5); used for progress and encouragement

max_recommended_passes.title: Max Recommended Passes
max_recommended_passes.description: Recommended maximum sort passes per participant (≥ min expected, ≤ 10); hard limit is max + 1

include_ai_agents.title: Include Ai Agents
include_ai_agents.description: When true, saved AI agents can be queued; when false, the selection is kept but ignored at queue time

ai_voter_models.title: Ai Voter Models
ai_voter_models.description: Unique LLM model keys that vote as AI agents; __default__ uses the resolved default model

option_questions_per_group.title: Option Questions Per Group
option_questions_per_group.description: Pairwise comparisons per option group. Follows the Ford–Johnson default for the current option count unless option_questions_per_group_explicit is true

factor_questions_per_group.title: Factor Questions Per Group
factor_questions_per_group.description: Pairwise comparisons per factor-importance group. Follows the Ford–Johnson default for the current factor count unless factor_questions_per_group_explicit is true

option_questions_per_group_explicit.title: Option Questions Per Group Explicit
option_questions_per_group_explicit.description: True when option comparisons per group were set by the user instead of the Ford–Johnson default

factor_questions_per_group_explicit.title: Factor Questions Per Group Explicit
factor_questions_per_group_explicit.description: True when factor comparisons per group were set by the user instead of the Ford–Johnson default

project_created_by.title: Project Created By
project_created_by.description: The ID of the user who created the project

project_criteria_template.title: Project Criteria Template
project_criteria_template.description: ID of the last factor template applied, if any; later edits may diverge from the template

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: When true, input is closed and new comparisons are not accepted

end_time.title: End Time
end_time.description: Optional close datetime for comparison collection; None means no deadline

deleted_date.title: Deleted Date
deleted_date.description: Date project entry was deleted; if not None, entry is considered deleted and not active

project_tag.title: Project Tag
project_tag.description: Specific project tag optionally used to filter result set

page_index.title: Page Index
page_index.description: Index of the page for pagination

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Number of records per page for pagination
